tr.td: Secrets never committed to Git. Team members copy to .env and fill in local values.
Prevents .env, __pycache__, node_modules, and model artifacts from being committed.
Spins up PostgreSQL, Redis, backend, and frontend with one command. Ensures consistent local environments across team members.
Adds Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager for local monitoring. Separated from main compose to keep it optional.
make dev, make test, make deploy abstract complex Docker/CLI commands. Reduces onboarding friction.
Zero-config deploy to Railway.app. Defines build command, health checks, and restart policy.
Onboarding guide for new developers. Explains setup, architecture, and deployment.
Loads env vars with type validation. settings.DATABASE_URL is used everywhere. Change .env → no code changes needed.
Creates the FastAPI instance, registers middleware, routes, and lifespan hooks. lifespan() loads the ML model at startup and closes DB connections on shutdown.
create_access_token() encodes user_id into JWT. get_current_user() dependency validates Bearer tokens on every protected route. bcrypt hashes passwords with salt.

RequestTimingMiddleware logs method, path, status, and duration for every request. Adds X-Request-ID header for distributed tracing. ErrorHandlingMiddleware catches unhandled exceptions and returns JSON error responses (prevents stack trace leaks).
NotFoundException, ValidationException provide consistent error format with machine-readable code field. Frontend uses code to show appropriate toast notifications.
JSONFormatter outputs logs as JSON for ELK/Grafana Loki ingestion. Includes request_id, user_id, and duration_ms for traceability.
Creates QueuePool connection pool (reuses DB connections). pool_pre_ping=True verifies connections before use (handles DB restarts gracefully).
Stores signup_date, acquisition_channel, device_type. events relationship enables user.events lazy loading.
Stores 1M+ events. properties is JSONB for flexible metadata. Indexed on (user_id, timestamp) and (event_type, timestamp) for fast analytics queries.
Pre-aggregated session metrics (duration, page_views). Reduces ML feature computation time.
Experiment table stores hypothesis and status. ExperimentAssignment stores variant assignments with unique constraint on (experiment_id, user_id).
Repository pattern abstraction. get_by_id(), get_by_channel() methods encapsulate query logic for testability.
get_events_for_user(), get_events_by_type() provide clean interfaces for complex filtered queries.
get_db() yields a DB session that auto-closes. get_current_user_id() injects authenticated user ID into routes via FastAPI's Depends().
Collects all v1 routers under /api/v1 prefix. Enables API versioning (future /api/v2/).
/health/ returns 200 for load balancer health checks. /ready verifies DB connectivity before accepting traffic (used by Kubernetes).
/auth/login accepts OAuth2 password flow, returns JWT access + refresh tokens. /auth/refresh exchanges refresh token for new access token.
/analytics/metrics → DAU/WAU/MAU. /analytics/funnel → 6-stage conversion. /analytics/cohorts/retention → retention matrix. All use AnalyticsService.
/experiments/{id}/assign/{user_id} → deterministic hash assignment. /experiments/{id}/results → Z-test statistical analysis.
/ml/churn/predict → batch churn prediction. /ml/churn/user/{id} → single user prediction. Loads XGBoost model at startup.
Contains all raw SQL queries using CTEs and window functions. get_cohort_retention() self-joins users with events by month. get_funnel_analysis() uses CASE-based aggregation.
get_channel_funnel() compares conversion rates across acquisition channels. Enables channel optimization decisions.
get_channel_retention() pivots retention data by channel. Used for "which channel has best retention?" insights.
calculate_sample_size() runs power analysis before experiment launch. conclude_experiment() archives results and stops data collection.
ABTestAnalyzer.analyze_proportions() runs Z-test via statsmodels. Returns p-value, confidence intervals, and power. required_sample_size() uses NormalIndPower for pre-experiment planning.
assign_variant() uses MD5 hash of experiment_id:user_id to deterministically assign variants. Same inputs always produce same output. No DB lookup required.
compute_proportion_metric() counts conversions per variant. Supports custom event types (purchase, signup, etc.).
generate_summary() creates markdown reports with statistical results for stakeholder communication.
RFMFeatureEngineer transforms raw user data into Recency, Frequency, Monetary + engagement features. sklearn transformer interface enables pipeline composition.
ChurnModelTrainer fetches data from PostgreSQL, engineers features, trains 3 models (XGBoost, Random Forest, Logistic Regression), evaluates with 5-fold CV, saves best model as joblib artifact.

ChurnPredictor loads model artifact at startup. predict() fetches user features from DB, engineers them identically to training, returns sorted risk scores. Singleton pattern ensures one model instance.
evaluate_model() computes AUC-ROC, precision, recall, F1, and confusion matrix. Used for model monitoring and drift detection.
Contains trained model + feature columns + metadata. Versioned filename enables rollback if new model degrades.
Self-join pattern with DATE_TRUNC('month', ...) groups users by signup month and counts retained users per period.
CASE WHEN aggregation with MAX() handles multiple events per user. Computes drop-off between each stage.
Conditional COUNT(DISTINCT) in single pass. Computes stickiness as DAU/MAU ratio.
execute_query() loads SQL files and renders them with Jinja2 templating. Separates SQL from Python code.
UserCreate validates incoming data. UserResponse defines API output shape. from_attributes=True enables ORM mode.
FunnelResponse, CohortResponse type the API responses. Frontend TypeScript types can be auto-generated from these.
ExperimentCreate validates metric_type against allowed values. ABTestAnalysis structures statistical results.
db_engine creates in-memory SQLite. db_session provides isolated transactions (rolled back after each test). client provides HTTP test client.
Verifies Z-test produces significant results for known data (324/1000 vs 365/1000). Verifies sample size calculations return reasonable values.
Verifies deterministic assignment (same input → same output). Verifies even distribution across 10,000 assignments.
Generates 50K users with channel-biased retention and 1.2M events with realistic funnel drop-offs. Uses NumPy vectorization for speed. Seeds database via SQLAlchemy bulk insert.
Standalone container for data seeding. Runs once via docker compose --profile seed up.
React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Recharts, Tailwind, Zustand, Axios.
Path alias @/ → ./src/. Proxy /api to localhost:8000 for dev. Code splitting into vendor/charts/query chunks.
Strict mode enabled. Path mapping for clean imports.
Custom color palette (CSS variables), border radius, font family. Dark mode via class strategy.
Creates React root, wraps app in QueryClientProvider and BrowserRouter.
Layout shell with Sidebar, Header, and Routes.
Tailwind directives, CSS variables for theming, custom scrollbar, heatmap hover effects, skeleton shimmer animation.
cn() merges Tailwind classes with tailwind-merge (prevents class conflicts).
formatNumber(), formatPercent(), formatCurrency(), formatDate(), formatDuration(). Centralized formatting for consistency.
Risk thresholds, funnel stage names, channel colors. Changing a threshold here updates the entire UI.
Stores JWT token in memory + localStorage. isAuthenticated derived from token presence. logout() clears everything.
Sidebar collapse state, theme preference, toast notifications. Lightweight alternative to Redux.
Base URL, request interceptor adds JWT header, response interceptor handles 401 redirects.
Typed methods for metrics, funnel, cohorts, revenue endpoints. Uses TanStack Query keys for caching.
getResults(), assignVariant() methods with proper TypeScript return types.
useMetrics(), useFunnel(), useCohortRetention() wrap TanStack Query with 5-minute stale time.
useLogin(), useLogout() mutations. Handles token storage and cache invalidation.
useExperimentResults() fetches and caches A/B test analysis.
Interfaces for API responses: MetricsResponse, FunnelStage, CohortResponse, ChurnPrediction.
ExperimentResult, ABTestAnalysis interfaces ensure type safety across frontend.
Responsive sidebar with nav links, active state styling, system status indicator.
Search input, notification bell with unread indicator, user profile dropdown.
animate-pulse div with configurable dimensions. Matches content shape to reduce layout shift.
Displays value, trend arrow, and percentage change. Color-coded for positive/negative trends.
Grid of colored cells representing retention rates. Hover tooltip shows exact percentage. Legend for color scale.
Horizontal bar chart via Recharts. Shows users per stage and drop-off percentages.
Small line chart for dashboard cards. Shows 7-day trend without axis labels.
4 KPI cards + retention heatmap + funnel chart. Uses useMetrics, useFunnel, useCohortRetention hooks. Shows skeleton loaders during data fetch.
Full-page retention heatmap + channel comparison cards. Best/worst channel identification.
Funnel chart + critical insight alert card. Identifies highest drop-off stage with recommendation.
Summary cards (total scored, high risk, at-risk revenue) + sortable predictions table with risk level badges and probability bars.
Control vs Treatment comparison cards. Statistical metrics (lift, p-value, power, significance). Recommendation banner with color coding.
Theme toggle, notification preferences, API key management.
Multi-stage build: deps → runtime. Non-root user for security. Gunicorn with Uvicorn workers for production ASGI serving.
Multi-stage: Node build → Nginx serve. Security headers (X-Frame-Options, CSP). Gzip compression.
Runs seed.py once and exits. Used with Docker Compose profiles.
Production-optimized with health checks, read-only filesystem, and security scanning.
Nginx with hardened security headers and static asset caching.
Routes /api/ to backend, /ws/ to WebSocket, serves static files, SPA fallback to index.html.
VPC, ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis, ALB, Route53, ACM SSL. Auto-scaling based on CPU/memory.
Environment-specific values (instance sizes, domain name, secrets). Validated with constraints.
ECS task execution role, task role, RDS monitoring role. Least-privilege permissions.
ALB DNS, RDS endpoint, Redis endpoint, ECR URL. Displayed after terraform apply.
Runs on PR/push. Steps: lint (flake8), type check (mypy), security scan (bandit), unit tests (pytest), coverage upload (Codecov).
Runs on PR/push. Steps: npm ci, npm run lint, TypeScript check, production build.
Triggered on main branch merge. Builds Docker image, pushes to ECR, updates ECS task definition, deploys service.
Triggered on main branch. Uses Railway CLI for zero-downtime deploy.
Defines targets: backend /metrics, node-exporter, postgres-exporter, redis-exporter. 15s scrape interval.
Critical alerts: HighErrorRate (>5%), HighLatency (>500ms), ModelDegradation (AUC<0.75), ServiceDown.
Routes critical alerts to PagerDuty, warnings to Slack. Email fallback for all alerts.
Auto-registers Prometheus as default data source on Grafana startup.
Availability, request rate, latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), active users, revenue by channel.

pre.code: make reset # Full reset: DB + seed + train make dev # Start backend make dev-front # Start frontend

div.div: Retention Analytics Platform — Complete File Operations Guide
